prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Scan the area. If object is visible, move to it, pick it up, move it, perform task. Else, search another area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInReach    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToPickLocation    /> <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = SearchAnotherArea    /> <Action ID = MoveToApproachLocation    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO MoveToPickLocation
	ELSE
		DO PickUpObject
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDestination
	ELSE
		DO SpecificTask
	END
